title: Cancellation of an Air Ticket Fare Brands Ticket and What It Returns
content:
Only the traveller may cancel their own Air Ticket Fare Brands ticket, and the cancellation is confirmed by the traveller rather than performed on their behalf.

## 1. What the traveller must state

The traveller states in this conversation that they are cancelling the whole itinerary and not a single traveller on it. This is a matter of what the traveller says; the booking record supplies the number of travellers the itinerary carries, and the two are read together against this booking's own reference.

## 2. The void window

A cancellation is handled under the risk-free void terms only when frozen time is not after the moment the traveller's ticket was issued for this booking plus the void window of the fare brand held. The void window is counted in whole elapsed hours from the ticket issue moment, never mixing elapsed hours with calendar days, and a cancellation confirmed exactly at the boundary is still inside the window.

Inside the void window every cancellation returns the whole amount paid to the original form of payment, whatever the fare brand held and whatever the brand's refund form, and no penalty is withheld.

## 3. Outside the void window

Outside the void window the fare brand decides everything.

| The brand held | What is returned |
| --- | --- |
| not refundable | nothing |
| refund form of a travel credit | the value on a voucher |
| refund form of the original form of payment | money to the card |

The penalty withheld is read off the brand's cancellation ladder by how many whole days lie between the cancellation and the outbound departure, and the ladder's flat penalty applies only where the ladder is silent.

A cancellation confirmed later than the brand's cancellation deadline before departure is treated as a no-show, and the no-show penalty replaces the cancellation penalty.

## 4. The amount returned

The amount returned is the amount paid on the booking less the cancellation penalty withheld, and never less than nothing: where the penalty is the larger of the two, the amount returned is nothing rather than a negative figure.

## 5. Lodging a claim

A refund claim is lodged only when the back office has already recorded an approved refund review against this booking. The authority is that recorded review, correlated to this booking by the review's own reference; a traveller's account of having been promised a refund is not that record.

## 6. Taxes and the service fee

Taxes and carrier fees that the airline itself refunds are returned even on a non-refundable brand, and the agency service fee is not.

## 7. Hypothetical boundary readings

On a brand whose void window is 24 hours, a cancellation confirmed exactly 24 elapsed hours after the ticket issue moment is inside the window, and the whole amount paid goes back to the card even on a brand whose refund form is a travel credit; one confirmed 24 hours and one minute after it falls outside, and section 3 governs.

On a brand whose cancellation deadline is 3 hours before departure, a cancellation confirmed 4 hours before departure is inside the deadline and is priced off the ladder; one confirmed 2 hours before departure is later than the deadline and is treated as a no-show instead.
